missing_169_by_family.constraints: Fixed feet; bar on upper back; knees and hips flex together. Preserve stance/depth and ground-band anchors per ID.
Front shoulder contact and high elbows remain stable; full-foot squat and stand.

Foot pressure fixed; load stays at the source location: single goblet, two rack kettlebells, two side dumbbells, or low central load. Do not interchange them.
Box contact is deliberate seated pause, trunk stays braced. Bands must attach to actual ground/top anchors; 275 needs fast ascent and controlled descent.
Touch bench lightly and reverse without resting; distinguish from box squat.
Knees remain planted; hips sit toward heels and extend to tall kneeling; no standing knee squat.
Bar contacts elbow crooks; preserve front load and prevent bar rolling.
Bar travels between legs with hands in front/behind and source stance; change orientation between sets, not every rep.
One foot stays planted; free leg stays in front and clears ground; kettlebell at chest. Owned depth without free-foot support.
Front foot fixed; rear toes on floor for 54 and rear foot on bench for 18. Preserve each support contact.
Step forward, descend, push back to original stance. Source determines side order; 136 completes one side before switching.
Step backward then return. 194 begins on low platform and rear foot steps off; cannot reuse level-floor contacts unchanged.
Fixed wide stance, weight shifts laterally to bending lead knee; trailing leg remains long with slight bend.
Lead foot stays fully on stable box; floor foot does not jump. 286 adds explicit free-knee raise, others finish ordinary stand.
Lunge with contralateral lead leg; kettlebell passes under front thigh to the other hand, then return and alternate. Show continuous handoff without teleporting.
Bar starts on floor; arms remain long, bar close to legs, hips/knees extend together. 46 has raised feet; band direction differs in 176/257.
Wide feet, knees out, arms inside legs, close floor pull. 258 bands above; 290 short bands under feet.
Bar begins behind calves and remains behind legs; do not depict conventional deadlift bar in front.
Soft knees remain at chosen angle, hips travel back with long trunk, front load close to legs. Preserve individual owned endpoint.
Hip hinge with bar on upper back or band at source shoulder/feet attachment; do not turn it into front-loaded deadlift.
Bar initially rests on pins at stomach height with torso near horizontal; extend hips, return bar to pins and settle.
Seat contact and feet remain fixed; hinge torso toward preset pins, pause just above rather than rest on them, return upright.
Stance foot fixed, opposite-hand kettlebell hangs under shoulder; free leg extends backward, hips remain square.
Ankle cuff at low pulley, free hand supports balance; small working-leg hip extension with fixed pelvis/torso and controlled return.
Ballistic hip hinge; relaxed long arms follow bell. Source must specify grip, bell arc and endpoint; no slow squat/front raise alias.
Upper back stays on bench; padded bar on hips; planted feet; hips extend to shoulders/knees level without lumbar overextension.
Knees padded, ankles secured; hips remain straight; body lowers as one lever from knees. Hands catch floor and visibly assist return.
Secured ankles and fixed knee support; straight hips lower then return with a visible band assisting reversal. Resolve attachment and assistance vector.
Forefoot stays on support and heel moves via ankle; quiet knees/hips, top pause, controlled heel return. 165 support on versus load in hands remains unresolved.
Supported upper back/feet; elbows bend and extend with load on intended press path. Preserve grip, single/bilateral load, touch point, and bands; 3 includes competition pause.
Legs secured on decline bench; lower to source low-chest point and press; do not reuse flat bench angle.
Incline bench/head/feet support; loaded press with source angle, grip and shoulder/elbow path. 212/218 source identity currently duplicates.
Upper arms contact floor at bottom and pause as sourced; stable shoulders/hips. 128 alternating, 249 single kettlebell; 196 extended range is unresolved.
Secured boards visibly sit on chest; bar touches board surface and pauses, then press. Board cannot be a floating marker.
Bar starts and finishes resting on actual rack pins at chosen height; full pause each rep; chest need not be touched.
Each ID has a distinct staged elbow/shoulder sequence; 177 explicitly alternates a full decline press and skull-crusher. Do not collapse into ordinary bench press.
Chest-height pulleys behind athlete; stable staggered stance and forward press; source 279 lacks this actual setup and conflicts with standing support.
Rigid trunk, fixed hands/toes, chest lowers and elbows extend; 170 hands on end-standing dumbbell must show exact contact and stable base.
Feet on bench, hands on floor; preserve both contacts and rigid trunk through full return.
High hips form inverted V; head lowers just ahead of hands; do not drift into horizontal push-up.
Hands floor, feet wall, head pad contact at bottom; overhead elbow extension with inverted body. Stage entry/exit separately.
Controlled up-to-five-second descent to pad, then explicit rehearsed side exit and reset; no invented unassisted concentric return.
Hands leave floor during push; short lateral step and slight body turn; land softly, reset line, traverse full circle. Requires ballistic contact phases.
Hands on two parallel bars, feet suspended; elbow flex to upper arms parallel and extend; no bench support alias.
Hands on bench edge behind body, bent knees/floor feet; hips clear edge, elbows back, owned shoulder range and return.
Hands grip fixed chest-height rack bar; feet back; rigid trunk moves toward bar as elbows bend, extends away; shoulders remain stable.
Braced standing or explicitly labelled seated source variant; load begins at shoulder and finishes overhead with long elbow. Rotation, bilateral/alternate/seesaw timing and pulley anchors are per ID.
Seat/floor support and planted feet or wide floor legs fixed; source rack-to-overhead path and grip preserved. 229 is floor seated, not bench seated.
Short vertical dip, leg/hip drive, then overhead elbow lockout; rack reset before next rep. Do not replace with strict press.
Locked overhead arm and bell remain stacked as legs squat; other arm forward, whole foot remains planted.
Elbows out at shoulder height, external-rotate forearms upward, then press; reverse distinct stages. Grip/axial rotation needs visible detail.
Bell stays positioned above while torso moves under, hips shift and elbow becomes long; stand under locked arm. Not a simple shoulder press.
Fixed overhead hand grips, quiet full hang and source upper-chest/chin endpoint, controlled full return. 6 requires secured external load attachment.
Underhand pull and bent-knee crunch occur together; nose to bar/knees to chest, return full hang with knees still bent.
Thigh pads/seat/feet fixed; source handle/grip and high cable; elbows pull down/back then arms regain full overhead reach.
Opposite high handles cross overhead, sweep down while palms turn toward each other; full crossed return, not V-bar alias.
Feet braced, knees soft, upright quiet torso; low pulley to stomach, full arm reach. 195 seat platform must be shown.
Quiet hinged torso; arms pull elbows back then regain long reach; implement, supinated/neutral grip and landmine pivot are explicit per-ID source requirements.
Bar pivots from anchored landmine under straddled stance; fixed hinge and neutral handle pulls plates toward chest, long-arm floating-plate return.
Hinged body, non-rowing kettlebell/hand contacts floor; row one bell and return it before other starts. Do not depict both as floating.
Hands fixed to hip-height bar, heels floor and trunk rigid; chest moves to bar then arms lengthen.
Wide-foot plank with one hand on stable dumbbell; alternate rowing arm to ribs, return load to floor; hips never twist.
Arms long with fixed soft elbow; sweep horizontally apart toward shoulder plane from front handles. 131 standing band anchor is source-specific.
Chest supported on shallow incline (188), flat bench (241), or incline (261); fixed soft elbow, lateral arm arc to source parallel endpoint; 188/241 one-second hold.
Seated forward hinge fixed; lateral sweep with soft elbow. 162 crossed low cable handles; 265 dumbbells start behind calves.
Fixed soft elbow and quiet trunk; arms lift laterally to sourced shoulder endpoint. 236 bands under feet, 272 seated and current tilt cue needs technique review.
Quiet standing trunk; soft fixed elbow, arm(s) in front to source shoulder endpoint. 206 one-arm low cable from behind, not dumbbell alias.

Hands/implement stay close to torso, elbows lead upward above hands toward source high endpoint. Bar versus low cable versus foot-anchored bands require different vectors and independent shoulder-ROM review.
Supine/reclined bench 30–60 degrees, head supported; elbows straight, palms down, front arm raise slightly above shoulder level. Different from held prone 135/187.
Chest on incline bench and elbows long; shoulder blades retract together then return. Do not turn into a curl, row or arm raise.

Supinated ascent, explicit pronation at top, pronated descent and bottom reset; not same grip throughout.
Upper arms fixed on pad, full natural long-arm start/return, shoulder quiet. Grip and cable/DB/bar distinct; 276 chest/stomach on angled side of preacher bench.
Seated wide feet, back of upper arm on inner thigh; isolated elbow curl full long-arm return, then change sides.
Chest on incline bench, shoulders near top, upper arms hang vertically and remain still; supinated dumbbell curl and full return.
Back supported incline, upper arms hang still; supinated for 219, neutral for 221; full natural elbow extension at return.
Upper arms held out horizontally toward high pulleys; forearms curl handles to ears and extend back without shoulder movement.
Body on floor, feet braced and legs straight toward low pulley; upper arms quiet by torso, curl bar to chest then return.
High pulley, upper arms pinned to ribs; forearms extend to thighs then controlled bend. Underhand 262 and spreading rope 292 must be visible.
Flat support; upper arms fixed, forearms lower toward ears/forehead or right-angle low cable source, then extend. Do not rotate entire shoulder.
Legs secured decline bench, upper arms fixed above chest; DB beside ears versus EZ bar to forehead, full controlled return.
Incline support, upper arms fixed close to head; elbow extension from behind head with source cable-high or barbell loading.
Knees floor, head/back of upper arms contact transverse bench; high cable behind, extend forearms to horizontal and return.
Overhead-to-thigh shoulder arc conflicts with instruction to hold upper arms stationary. Need decide intended fixed-elbow shoulder action versus elbow extension.
Supine flat support; fixed soft elbows, wide shoulder arc opening to owned stretch then hands meet over chest; 201 actual low cable anchors.
Secured decline legs/support; fixed soft elbows and wide arc, hands meet over chest, controlled return.
Supported low incline, soft elbow fixed; wide arc to owned chest stretch then hands meet over chest/face as sourced; 217 low pulley vectors.
Flat bench body supported, bar over chest; fixed bent elbows while shoulder arc carries bar behind head and back.
Only shoulders on perpendicular bench, hips low, feet floor; one DB both palms under end. 149 fixed bent elbows, 289 straight elbows throughout.
High cable, slight standing hinge; arms sweep from overhead/front to thighs via shoulders, elbows fixed long/soft as sourced.
Forearms supported thighs, wrists beyond knees; palms-up wrist flex and extended return; 164 bar low cable, 269 DB.
Forearms supported, palms down; hand backs lift through wrist without lifting elbows; full controlled return.
Need decide finger opening/closing versus wrist curl; generic source currently offers either. Arm-only rig cannot show finger action.
Prone floor; chest/arms/legs lift a few inches in low long arc and return. Avoid exaggerated lumbar hyperextension.

Legs secured, low back support; 119 short shoulder-blade curl, 181 adds one-side oblique turn; not full rigid sit-up.
Pelvis rolls and tailbone lifts; knees travel toward ribs with quiet shoulders. 99 ankle low cable; 183 secured decline bench and source leg start.
Hands fixed high bar, arms long; legs lift to at least parallel within owned range plus pelvic curl, controlled dead-hang return.
Knees floor and rope by ears, hips quiet; torso curls through spine. 232 normal/left/right sequential turns, 263 missing setup remains source hold.
Back toward high pulley, rope across upper chest/shoulders; hips fixed, spine curls and returns. Do not use kneeling or hip hinge alias.
Upper back supported on stability ball, hips raised, feet planted, arms over chest; thorax quarter-turn away from pulley and return while pelvis stays quiet.
Side-on high pulley, near hand fixed at shoulder/elbow at side; torso side-bends toward cable then returns upright without turning.
Kneeling support, bar rolls on floor while arms long and hips extend without sag; 137 knees on bench with bar on floor below bench end.
Bell begins on floor, close hip-driven rise, hand rolls through handle to rack without forearm impact, reverse to floor and reset.
Locked vertical bell arm throughout floor-to-elbow/hand-to-one-knee-to-standing stages and exact reverse. 68 specifies leg sweep; 231 lunge-style path must retain its own stage sequence.

legacy_exclusion_reassessment.cautions: Keep the exact source setup, support, implement/grip, endpoint, cues and controlled return below. Membership in a shared family is not evidence of per-ID geometry equivalence.
Legacy exclusion was a three-frame format limitation. A named in-place stride demo is possible; distinguish stance and flight/contact phases.
Existing intentionally_unsuitable status belongs to limited prototype. Complex but representable in staged multi-view sequence; no completed review or approval implied.
Existing prototype exclusion does not mean impossible. Need continuous bar path and non-teleporting shoulder catch with changed elbow configuration.
No blanket convenience exclusion: choose/label walking and/or running contact cycles and terrain limitations. Current source does not choose one.
